insights.debrief.lead: {n} findings stand out in {matches} matches with {persons} players and {rows} rows.
insights.debrief.nothing: Nothing stands out: at a false discovery rate of {fdr}, everything here is within what chance explains. More matches sharpen the picture.
insights.debrief.headline: Clearest of all ({conf}): {text}.
insights.debrief.weak: {n} of them rest on weaker evidence: leads to check, not facts.
insights.debrief.notCounted: Find the insights first: the debrief is written from them.
insights.ai.title: External AI
insights.ai.off: Off: the debrief is written in the viewer and nothing leaves this computer.
insights.ai.settingsTitle: Pick a provider, an endpoint, a model and your key
insights.ai.writeTitle: Send the findings and a few totals (no rows) to the endpoint set in the AI settings and let its model write the debrief
insights.ai.question: Ask something about the findings (optional)
insights.ai.keyLocal: API key (most local servers need none)
insights.ai.keyHint: Goes only to the base URL above. Never logged, never in saved views, exports or .3dheat files.
insights.ai.remember: Remember the key in this browser
insights.ai.namesHint: Off: players go as P1, P2…
insights.ai.err.config: Set a base URL and a model in the AI settings first.
insights.ai.err.network: Could not reach {url}. Check the address; the host may not accept calls from a web page (CORS).
insights.ai.err.cors: No answer from {url}. Is the server running, and does it accept calls from {origin}? Ollama: set OLLAMA_ORIGINS={origin} and restart it. LM Studio: turn on CORS in the server settings.
insights.ai.err.mixed: This page is on https and {url} on http: the browser blocks that. Give the endpoint https, or open the viewer from localhost.
insights.ai.err.notFound: Not found ({status}): check the base URL and the model. {detail}
insights.ai.err.rate: Rate limit or credit used up ({status}); try again later. {detail}
insights.cast.pickMatch: The caster follows one replay: pick a match.
insights.cast.unavailable: This data has no players and kill or capture events to find moments in.
insights.cast.none: Nothing in this match to cast: no kills, deaths or captures.
insights.cast.jumpTitle: Go there: the playhead just before it, the camera on the action, following the player
insights.cast.say.trade: {victim} goes down, and {actor} trades back on {other} within {secs}.
insights.cast.say.clutchLost: {actor}, last of {team} against {against}, falls after {kills} kills.
insights.cast.say.clutchOpen: {actor} is the last of {team}, alone against {against}.
insights.cast.say.swing: {team} swings it back, {secs} after the other side's capture.
insights.cast.say.comeback: {team} climbs back from {deficit} down and takes the lead.
insights.cast.say.standout: {actor} stands out among {class}: {kills} kills where the average is {mean}.
insights.cast.say.struggle: A hard match for {actor}: {kills} kills and {deaths} deaths, where {class} average {mean} kills.
